# Keian Luxandor

> Keian Luxandor sells certified loose diamonds: GIA-graded natural diamonds and IGI-graded lab-grown diamonds. Every stone has a laser-inscribed girdle and 40x macro video inspection. Delivery within India is complimentary, international orders are handled by enquiry, and returns are accepted within 30 days. Buyers can speak with a certified gemologist on WhatsApp or by phone, or visit the showroom in Baner, Pune by appointment (Monday to Saturday, 11:00 am to 7:30 pm IST).

## Shop

- [All Diamonds](https://keianluxandor.in/diamonds): Full catalogue of certified loose diamonds, filterable by shape (round, oval, cushion, emerald, pear, princess, radiant, asscher, marquise, heart)
- [Natural Diamonds](https://keianluxandor.in/diamonds/natural): GIA-graded natural diamonds
- [Lab-Grown Diamonds](https://keianluxandor.in/diamonds/lab-grown): IGI-graded lab-grown diamonds
- [New This Month](https://keianluxandor.in/diamonds?sort=newest): Most recently added stones
- [The Collection](https://keianluxandor.in/shop): Curated collection
